cells.note: Before-and-after comparison; patients admitted before the workshop formed the pre-intervention cohort and those admitted after formed the post-intervention cohort.

O.outcome_detail: in-hospital mortality among pediatric AKI cases

cells.quote: Significant independent predictors of mortality included hypovolemic shock (OR 8.73, 95% CI 2.13–35.76, p = 0.008), severe dehydration (OR 5.29, 95% CI 1.57–17.86, p = 0.009), and hypernatremia (OR 4.18, 95% CI 1.02–17.06, p = 0.045)
cells.note: This is an observational association, not an instructional intervention; the study also reports hospital-stratified analysis for severe dehydration.

O.outcome_detail: correct answers on nephrotoxic-medication questionnaire items

cells.quote: Less than a third knew that furosemide, lisinopril and valsartan were potentially nephrotoxic while 67(82.7%) knew that NSAIDs were nephrotoxic.
cells.note: The study was a cross-sectional questionnaire survey with no instructional manipulation; the contrast is between medication items within the same knowledge assessment.

D.treatment: Knowledge that serum creatinine may be normal in AKI

cells.quote: Only 33(40.7%) of the respondents knew that serum creatinine may be normal in patients with AKI while 42(51.9%) knew that urine output may be adequate in AKI patients.
cells.note: Descriptive cross-sectional frequency; the study did not manipulate a treatment or report a statistical comparison for this item.
